trajectory.description: Won the Copa do Brasil with Santos as top scorer with 42 goals in 60 appearances across all competitions.

trajectory.title: Copa Libertadores winner and Best Player
trajectory.description: Led Santos to their first Copa Libertadores title since 1963, named Best Player of the tournament, and won the FIFA Puskás Award and South American Footballer of the Year.

trajectory.title: Transferred to Barcelona
trajectory.description: Signed for FC Barcelona for a reported €57 million, joining Lionel Messi and Luis Suárez to form the 'MSN' attacking trio.

trajectory.title: Treble winner with Barcelona
trajectory.description: Won the treble (La Liga, Copa del Rey, Champions League) with Barcelona, scoring 39 goals including in the Champions League final.

trajectory.title: Olympic gold with Brazil
trajectory.description: Led Brazil to their first-ever Olympic gold medal at the Rio 2016 Games, scoring the winning penalty in the final against Germany.

trajectory.title: World record transfer to PSG
trajectory.description: Transferred to Paris Saint-Germain for €222 million, becoming the most expensive player in football history.

trajectory.title: Champions League final with PSG
trajectory.description: Helped PSG reach their first-ever Champions League final, named to the UEFA Team of the Year.

trajectory.title: Brazil's all-time top scorer
trajectory.description: Surpassed Pelé as Brazil's all-time leading goalscorer with 79 international goals; joined Al-Hilal in Saudi Arabia before returning to Santos in 2025.

name: Avicii
milestone_by_age_26: Released the single 'Levels' in 2011 at age 22, which became a global hit certified platinum in multiple countries and launched him to international stardom; his debut album True (2013) reached the top 10 in over 15 countries.
starting_point: Born in 1989 in Stockholm, Sweden; mother was actress Anki Lidén; father ran an office supply business; began producing music at 16 using FL Studio in his bedroom, posting remixes on electronic music forums.
current_position: Died on April 20, 2018 at age 28 in Muscat, Oman; final status: Swedish DJ and producer who brought EDM to Top 40 radio; posthumous album 'Tim' released in 2019.

trajectory.title: Signed with Dejfitts Plays label
trajectory.description: Signed with the small Swedish label Dejfitts Plays as a teenager, adopting the stage name Avicii (from the lowest level of hell in Buddhist cosmology).

trajectory.title: Early singles and Tiësto residency
trajectory.description: Released singles 'Bromance' and 'My Feelings for You' and earned a weekly residency at Privilege in Ibiza through Tiësto's support.

trajectory.title: 'Levels' global breakthrough
trajectory.description: Released 'Levels,' which became a global hit certified platinum in at least 10 countries, launching him to international stardom.

trajectory.title: Debut album 'True' and 'Wake Me Up'
trajectory.description: Released debut album 'True,' which reached the top 10 in over 15 countries; lead single 'Wake Me Up' became the most-streamed song on Spotify and hit #1 in 22 countries.

trajectory.title: Ultra Music Festival controversy
trajectory.description: Debuted the country-EDM fusion 'Wake Me Up' at Ultra Music Festival to boos from the crowd, but the song became a massive global hit within weeks.

trajectory.title: Second album 'Stories' and arena tours
trajectory.description: Released 'Stories' and became the first EDM DJ to pull off a worldwide arena tour, earning $19 million according to Forbes.

trajectory.title: Retirement from touring
trajectory.description: Announced retirement from touring due to health problems including acute pancreatitis and opioid addiction, performing his final gig in Ibiza in August 2016.

trajectory.title: Final EP 'Avīci (01)'
trajectory.description: Released his final EP 'Avīci (01),' which reached #1 on the Swedish chart, months before his death.

trajectory.title: Death in Oman
trajectory.description: Died by suicide on April 20, 2018 while on vacation in Muscat, Oman, at age 28, prompting global mourning and discussions about mental health in the music industry.

trajectory.title: Posthumous album 'Tim'
trajectory.description: Posthumous album 'Tim' was released, reaching #1 on the Billboard Top Dance Albums chart, compiled from his unfinished recordings by family and collaborators.
